method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Cyclical rotation extends as tech recovers – Danske Bank
Equities.summary: Danske Research Team notes that global equities began August with fresh all-time highs in several MSCI indices. Gains were driven by sector rotation, with software rebounding 16% over the past week and lower Oil prices supporting sentiment.
Equities.reason: Broad market regime: cyclical rotation plus a strong software rebound and all-time highs signal bullish risk-on sentiment and tech leadership — high relevance for equity positioning.

Equities.title: Nasdaq futures underpinned by strong AI forecasts; focus on earnings, data
Equities.reason: AI-driven leadership is supporting Nasdaq futures and equity risk appetite; this is a dominant market narrative (earnings + AI) with material flow implications for tech-heavy indices.

Equities.title: Stocks Hold Near Record Highs as Earnings Roll In: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad-market wrap showing indices near records as earnings season progresses — reinforces a constructive macro/earnings backdrop for equities.

Equities.title: Wall Street rallies, Dow closes at record on Iran talks optimism
Equities.reason: Geopolitical de-escalation (Iran talks) trimming oil risk premium and lifting risk-on flows — positive but more event-driven than structural.

Equities.title: Amazon tops $3 trillion market cap as stock continues post-earnings surge
Equities.summary: Shares of Amazon hit a new all-time high Monday, putting its market cap over $3 trillion.
Equities.reason: Concentration in mega-cap tech: Amazon hitting a $3tn market cap underscores big-tech leadership driving broader indices — bullish for market internals but single-name concentration risk remains.

Equities.title: Palantir soars 12% on blowout quarter, with U.S. commercial revenue soaring nearly 150%
Equities.summary: Palantir's second-quarter earnings beat expectations, and the AI software company lifted revenue guidance.
Equities.reason: Strong AI-driven company earnings and upgraded guidance reinforce the AI leadership narrative; relevant to sector/tech sentiment though idiosyncratic.

Equities.title: Snap's stock jumps 8% on earnings beat and strong sales forecast
Equities.summary: Snap beat analysts' estimates across the board in its second-quarter earnings report.
Equities.reason: Another tech earnings beat that supports a positive near-term tech/advertising narrative — supportive but lower relevance than market-wide signals.

Equities.title: White House to host AI companies Tuesday to review new model-testing framework
Equities.summary: President Donald Trump’s June executive order directed officials to develop a process to evaluate the cybersecurity capabilities of advanced AI models.
Equities.reason: Regulatory oversight of AI introduces policy risk and potential constraints on AI business models — modestly negative for AI-driven equities given uncertainty around rules.

Equities.title: Big Tech's Anthropic and OpenAI stakes are distorting the corporate earnings picture
Equities.summary: If you were to strip out Big Tech's investment gains from private AI companies, the earnings story is a lot less bullish.
Equities.reason: Quality-of-earnings concern: investment/valuation marks from private AI stakes are inflating headline results — a meaningful counter-narrative that tempers bullish equity interpretation.

Rates.title: US Dollar: NFP and inflation mix complicate Fed path – BNY
Rates.summary: BNY strategists John Velis and David Tam highlight the July Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report and upcoming Consumer Price Index (CPI) releases as key inputs for the Fed. They see consensus around 80,000 jobs, with a breakeven near 50,000 to keep unemployment stead
Rates.reason: Data mix (NFP + CPI) keeps Fed on a data-dependent, potentially higher-for-longer stance — a hawkish impulse that pressures bond prices / lifts yields. Moderate relevance as it frames Fed policy risks.

Rates.title: Manufacturing survey shows inflation worries 'worse than pandemic era,' adding to Fed pressure
Rates.summary: The commentary pointed to a highly volatile environment in which purchasing managers were struggling to stay ahead
Rates.reason: Surveys signalling elevated inflation expectations heighten pressure on the Fed to remain restrictive — clear hawkish signal likely to push yields higher and weigh on bond prices; high relevance for rates.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statement is a primary driver of U.S. rate expectations; given current inflation/backdrop it likely reinforces higher-for-longer messaging — major negative for bond prices (yields up).

Rates.title: South Korea July inflation +2.8% y/y, weaker than expected
Rates.reason: Weaker-than-expected CPI in South Korea reduces near-term need for tighter policy there — supportive for local bond prices (yields lower). Regional inflation misses have modest relevance to global rates backdrop.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - July 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: Decision to hold Bank Rate is direct central-bank news but the item as presented is neutral; minutes could guide future path but no explicit hawkish/dovish content in the summary — treated as neutral/low signal for immediate rates direction.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ reducing JGB purchases removes a major buyer, adding supply-side pressure on JGBs and lifting yields — a material negative for bond prices in Japan and influential for global rates/flow dynamics.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: Updates to BOJ outright purchase schedule provide operational detail on JGB demand; reductions or re-timing of purchases are bearish for JGB prices and reinforce the BOJ-driven rates narrative (lower relevance than the BOJ review).

Rates.title: Race for Diaspora Dollars Pumps Up India’s Bond, Loan Markets
Rates.reason: Large diaspora dollar inflows into India support local bond and loan markets (demand for bonds), putting downward pressure on yields in India — constructive for EM local markets and relevant to global supply/demand dynamics in rates.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker at 2.7% in Q1 2027, indicating stable negotiated wage pressures
Rates.reason: ECB wage tracker showing stable negotiated wage growth moderates the inflation outlook for the euro area — mildly supportive for bond prices (lower yields) as wage-driven upside risks appear contained.

FX.title: United States Dollar holds gains amid Middle East uncertainty, hawkish Fed odds
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is extending its gains for the second successive day and trading around 100.00 during the European session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: DXY extending gains on Middle East risk and hawkish Fed odds is a clear USD-strength impulse — negative for non‑USD FX. High relevance because it describes a broad USD move rather than a single‑pair technical note.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Gains against US Dollar to remain limited – TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities strategists argue that recent Japanese Ministry of Finance (MoF) interventions and talk of joint United States (US)/Japan action have not changed the broader USD/JPY regime.
FX.reason: TD view that intervention hasn't altered the USD/JPY regime supports continued USD strength / limited JPY appreciation — a USD‑centric narrative with moderate relevance.

FX.title: Analysis: Federal Reserve may be pulled into Bessent’s effort to support Japan’s yen
FX.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants to defend the yen without selling Treasurys into a sensitive U.S. bond market. The Federal Reserve could help.
FX.reason: Potential Fed involvement in supporting the yen is a major FX regime event (USD selling / JPY support). High relevance because it implies US policy actors directly affecting USD flows and global FX markets.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Managed JPY signals new order – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank’s Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton highlights coordinated action between the US Treasury and Japan’s Ministry of Finance (MoF) to defend the Japanese Yen (JPY), framing it as a potential “financial Fort Sumter” in capital markets.
FX.reason: Describes coordinated US‑Japan action to defend the yen — reinforces a shift toward active currency defence and likely USD selling. Large market‑regime relevance for FX.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Joint intervention threat curtails selling – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Japanese Yen has weakened modestly in Asia, with USD/JPY near its 200‑day moving average around 158.00 after recent joint intervention by Japan and the US.
FX.reason: Notes that threat/occurrence of joint intervention is limiting JPY selling — supportive for JPY (negative for USD) with clear tactical market impact; moderate‑high relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Solid manufacturing and JOLTs in focus – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team underscores strong United States (US) cyclical signals, with the ISM manufacturing index rising to 55.6 in July, beating expectations and June’s reading. New orders, employment and production all improved, while prices moderated.
FX.reason: Stronger US macro data supports the USD (negative for other currencies). This is a material macro driver for USD flows, giving it above‑average FX relevance.

FX.title: Forex Today: Mideast uncertainty keeps USD supported ahead of next batch of US data
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, August 4:
FX.reason: Top‑line FX wrap highlighting geopolitical risk keeping the USD bid — reinforces the prevailing USD‑support narrative across the session.

FX.title: Timetable and Schedule of U.S. Dollar Funds-Supplying Operations (August-December 2026)
FX.reason: BOJ schedule for dollar funds‑supplying ops is a direct FX market operations signal. It eases dollar‑funding risk and is supportive for non‑USD FX liquidity (modest positive for FX vs USD).

FX.title: Citi Says Japan Has Yen Defense Tools Beyond Treasury Sales
FX.reason: Analysis that Japan has multiple tools to defend the yen implies sustained potential for intervention/support — a meaningful constraint on USD/JPY moves and a significant FX regime factor.

Commodities.reason: Direct demand shock from China (largest importer) reduces crude demand — negative for oil prices; medium relevance for global oil balances.

Commodities.title: Brent: Sharp drop questions supply fears – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank’s Senior Market Strategist Benjamin Picton notes Brent futures fell over 7% and Singapore gasoil nearly 11%, despite ongoing geopolitical and logistical disruptions to Oil and refined products.
Commodities.reason: Large, sudden drop in Brent prices despite ongoing disruptions signals a material repricing of oil risk-premium — high relevance for crude price regime and risk sentiment.

Commodities.summary: The results come as oil supermajors have reported blowout quarterly profits, benefitting from higher fossil fuel prices amid the Iran war.
Commodities.reason: Corporate earnings reflecting higher oil prices driven by Iran-related supply squeeze — supports bullish crude narrative and reflects tighter fundamentals.

Commodities.title: BP profits highest in four years as Iran war pushes up oil price

Commodities.title: Oil slides as Trump delays Iran strikes, signals peace talks

Commodities.title: Oil Edges Higher With Focus on Iran Negotiations, Hormuz Flows
Commodities.reason: Continued focus on Iran/Hormuz flows keeps upside risk present; modest positive for oil amid ongoing negotiations and flow uncertainty.
